# Feature: Guarded orb — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #19 (Guarded orb) from Orbs before it is used in real levels. Effect: steps one tile away when approached. Unique: the only orb that flees the player. Useful: a herding puzzle, solved by cornering it. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** steps one tile away when approached.

**So that** a herding puzzle, solved by cornering it.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Guarded orb for the first time in its teaching room (mech-19-guarded-orb-room). Teaching moment: First room: the guarded orb in an open area with one walled corner. A player who chases it directly follows it around the room without ever stepping on it, until they drive it toward the corner almost by accident, which teaches that the orb is herded rather than caught. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: When you come within two tiles it steps one tile away from you to a free floor tile, once per your move
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It cannot enter walls or water
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Drive it against a wall or block and you can step onto it

## Edge Cases & Rules

- It cannot enter walls or water
- Drive it against a wall or block and you can step onto it
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Guarded orb's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-19-guarded-orb-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/orbs.yml mechanic #19.
